isolationUnitEvidence.conclusion: a mandatory integrity label is a LEVEL, not a compartment: two ACTIVE worlds are both at Low, so neither can refuse the other

domain.assumption: capacity exclusion is scoped to this Windows principal on this machine: every confidential worker this principal can start contends for one slot, whatever repository or DSH home it serves. Different principals are not covered.
domain.ancestryChecked: every ancestor of the capacity root is lstat-inspected; a reparse point refuses the slot
